comment: dogmove.c mnum_leashable() 1463-1469: a debug Samurai leashes his little dog with a wished leash, then drops a wished small mimic corpse and steps off it. The dog eats it, and quickmimic() picks the little-dog entry of qm[] (an M_AP_MONSTER kitten disguise); because the dog was leashed, quickmimic() asks mnum_leashable(PM_KITTEN), which is TRUE, so the leash stays on. Seed, date and opening are shared with recipes/pager.c/mhidden_description-probed-pet-dog-masquerading-as-kitten; the leash steps are new.
